legend: In situ and invasive vulvar melanoma in a 66-year-old woman, with lentiginous pattern of growth.
Higher magnification of in situ and invasive melanoma with lentiginous pattern of growth.
Nodular-type vulvar melanoma with dense sheet-like proliferation of atypical melanocytes in the dermis/subepithelial stroma.
Vulvar melanoma in a 66-year-old woman, in-situ and invasive with lentiginous pattern of growth. Focal lichen sclerosus also present.
Vulvar melanoma, nodular type in a 66-year-old woman with dense sheet-like proliferation of atypical melanocytes (H&E).

Vaginal melanoma in a 49-year-old woman presenting with bleeding and mass. Biopsy shows dense sheet-like proliferation of atypical epithelioid cells with variable cytoplasmic pigmentation, primarily involving the subepithelial stroma.

Melanoma metastatic to uterus in a 58-year-old woman. Multinodular proliferation of atypical epithelioid cells with pale amphophilic to clear cytoplasm and hyperchromatic nuclei infiltrating the myometrium, in association with necrosis.
